main.description: Called by a Planetary instance to register a new user DID with the relay. The relay will begin tracking the DID's PDS repo for aggregate counts.

did.description: The user's DID (e.g. did:plc:xxx or did:web:handle.example.com).

pdsUrl.description: Base URL of the PDS hosting this DID's repo.

instanceUrl.description: Base URL of the Planetary instance announcing this user.

handle.description: The user's Planetary handle at time of announcement.

tracked.description: Whether the relay is now tracking this DID.
